title: Producir en casa
goal: Read how World War II, not the 1929 crisis alone, forced import substitution to become the region's dominant economic model -- and why governments deepened it after the war rather than abandoning it.

items: State when ISI truly became the region's dominant model.
Explain why Latin American countries were forced to manufacture domestically.
Describe what happened to many improvised wartime factories.
Explain what governments chose to do once postwar imports became available again.
Use no fue hasta que to pinpoint exactly when something finally happened.
